title: Nine Pounds and a Certificate
subtitle: 成功成就 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 成功成就（做人与做事·成功与成就）
meta: 主题语境：成功成就（做人与做事·成功与成就）　|　核心词汇：award　|　正文 322 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 award 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1976 my mother won ① an award of nine pounds and a certificate, and my father said the certificate was the expensive part. The ② award, meaning the money and not the evening, was spent on a coat and a bill; an award, she said, is the only money that arrives after the work and before the thanks. She said the thanks arrived eleven months later.

Every ③ award in that school was given on a Friday and forgotten by the Monday. Their ④ award with the nine names on it was shared and therefore nobody's; an award, my father said, is the only thing that is worth more when one person gets it. He said nine people sharing is nine people losing.

My uncle said an ⑤ award is a way of paying somebody for something you cannot pay for, and my grandmother said that was the truest thing he had ever said. The ⑥ award, meaning the idea and not the money or the certificate, is nine parts memory and one part paper; an award, she said, is the only payment that is given for what is already finished. She said the finishing is the hard part.

By 1980 the ⑦ award had become a dinner and the dinner had become a speech. The ⑧ award of damages, the lawyer wrote in March, would be nine thousand pounds or nothing; an award, my father said, is either a prize somebody gives you or a sum a court decides, and only one of them comes with a handshake. He said the handshake is the one you remember.

The ⑨ award I remember is the nine pounds, which paid for a coat my grandmother wore for eleven years. An ⑩ award, she said in 1984, is the only thing that proves somebody was watching and does not prove they understood; every award, she said, is a verdict given by people who were not there. She said the verdict is always late.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 奖；奖品（一个具体的奖）
B. n. 奖金（指那笔钱，与颁奖晚会相对）
C. n. 奖（指写有九个名字、被分享的那一个）
D. 固定搭配：win an award 获奖
E. n. 奖（抽象概念；这种荣誉）
F. n. 奖（指变成晚宴和演讲的那一个）
G. n. 赔偿额；裁定额（法律意义）
H. n. 奖（抽象总称；泛指）

items.q: an award of nine pounds and a certificate
The award, meaning the money and not the evening
Their award with the nine names
an award is a way of paying somebody
the award had become a dinner

answers.why: win an award 意为“获奖”，1976 年母亲获得了一个九镑加一张奖状的奖，父亲说奖状才是贵的那一部分。
award 意为“奖金”，指那笔钱，与颁奖晚会相对，这笔钱花在了一件外套和一张账单上。
award 意为“奖、奖品”，那所学校里每一个奖都是星期五颁发、星期一就被忘掉。
award 指写有九个名字、被分享的那一个奖，它被分给了九个人，因此谁的也不是。
award 为抽象总称，泛指“奖这种东西”，叔叔说奖是一种为你无法付钱的东西付钱的方式。
award 为抽象概念，指“奖这种荣誉”，而不是钱或奖状，是九分记忆加一分纸。
award 指变成晚宴和演讲的那一个奖，到 1980 年这个奖成了一场晚宴，晚宴又成了一篇演讲。
award 意为“赔偿额、裁定额（法律意义）”，律师三月写道，损害赔偿的裁定额要么是九千镑，要么什么也没有。
award 意为“奖、奖品”，我记得的是那九镑，它买了一件祖母穿了十一年的外套。
award 为抽象总称，她说奖是唯一能证明有人在看着、却不能证明他们看懂了的东西。
